source_split: 32 already selected dev mothers, original diagnostic mask; training prior only
metric_definition: per-position coarsened excess KL, realized NLL and CRPS, CFA means then mother mean; same candidates
limitations: Post hoc development diagnostic, not preregistered independent test.
Local constant 5x5 and empirical finite prior are modelling restrictions.
N0 has larger multiscale context; four-color access alone is not complete matching.
No causal attribution or claim of best classical estimator.
